scope: All concrete human shield designs missing from the existing campaign. Existing shield IDs retain their stats; creature-specific shields and abstract parents are excluded. Fixed representative heraldry/cosmetics.

item.name: Ancient Auxiliary Shield
item.description: A wooden light shield in oval shape. The wood seems brittle and old, making it less durable.
item.role: +15 melee defense, +15 ranged defense; 16 durability at a 10 fatigue cost.

item.name: Ancient Coffin Shield
item.description: An octagonal shield made of wood and reinforced with bronze. Time has taken its toll and the wood has become brittle.
item.role: +15 melee defense, +20 ranged defense; 20 durability at a 12 fatigue cost.

item.name: Ancient Tower Shield
item.description: A tall and heavy tower shield that offers good protection, but is very bulky to handle. It appears to be old and worn down.
item.role: +20 melee defense, +20 ranged defense; 24 durability at a 20 fatigue cost.

item.name: Heraldic Heater Shield
item.description: A triangular wooden shield covered with leather and canvas.
item.role: +20 melee defense, +15 ranged defense; 32 durability at a 14 fatigue cost.

item.name: Heraldic Kite Shield
item.description: An elongated wooden shield covered in leather that offers good protection also to the lower body. Somewhat bulky to handle in close combat engagements.
item.role: +15 melee defense, +25 ranged defense; 48 durability at a 16 fatigue cost.

item.name: Heraldic Wooden Shield
item.description: A round wooden shield.
item.role: +15 melee defense, +15 ranged defense; 24 durability at a 10 fatigue cost.

item.name: Gilder's Embrace
item.description: A rare gilder's embrace with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. An ornate metal shield with a bright gilded shine that reflects even the tiniest ray of light with the power of the sun itself. Adapted as equipment; source regeneration and magical effects are not simulated.
item.role: +32 melee defense, +25 ranged defense; 1226 durability at a 16 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Bandit Heater Shield
item.description: A rare bandit heater shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. A sturdy triangular shield well suited for close combat. This one is an exceptionally well-crafted and balanced exemplar.
item.role: +20 melee defense, +20 ranged defense; 49 durability at a 14 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Bandit Kite Shield
item.description: A rare bandit kite shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. A long, wooden shield covering the whole body for good protection against ranged attacks. This particular shield shows some unique craftsmanship and is a rare find.
item.role: +20 melee defense, +32 ranged defense; 48 durability at a 16 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Dragon Shield
item.description: A rare dragon shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. A large kite shield covered in drawings. Extraordinary craftsmanship went into making this piece.
item.role: +20 melee defense, +31 ranged defense; 48 durability at a 16 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Full Metal Heater Shield
item.description: A rare full metal heater shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. A finely crafted heater shield made almost entirely out of metal. Heavy and durable, yet lighter than it looks. The craftsmen who made this must have truly been a master of his trade.
item.role: +26 melee defense, +15 ranged defense; 94 durability at a 16 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Golden Round Shield
item.description: A rare golden round shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. A full metal round shield of extraordinary quality. This must have been the pride of any warrior boasting it.
item.role: +19 melee defense, +22 ranged defense; 60 durability at a 15 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Lindwurm Shield
item.description: A rare lindwurm shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. A sturdy wooden frame lays the base for a shimmering heap of rare Lindwurm scales to form a shield impenetrable.
item.role: +18 melee defense, +33 ranged defense; 48 durability at a 16 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Red White Shield
item.description: A rare red white shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. A large and thick wooden shield of foreign style. It offers great protection despite its peculiar form.
item.role: +20 melee defense, +25 ranged defense; 48 durability at a 12 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Rider On Horse Shield
item.description: A rare rider on horse shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. A relic heater shield covered in iconographic images. It seem to be old, yet is durable and well to handle.
item.role: +20 melee defense, +15 ranged defense; 32 durability at a 12 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Sipar Shield
item.description: A rare sipar shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. A full metal round shield of southern design with elaborate ornaments. Quite heavy, but also durable.
item.role: +23 melee defense, +18 ranged defense; 60 durability at a 15 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Undead Heater Shield
item.description: A rare undead heater shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. A triangular wooden shield covered with leather and canvas, old but very well balanced.
item.role: +28 melee defense, +15 ranged defense; 32 durability at a 10 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Undead Kite Shield
item.description: A rare undead kite shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. An elongated wooden shield that offers good protection also to the lower body, despite its apparent age. Somewhat bulky to handle in close combat engagements.
item.role: +20 melee defense, +25 ranged defense; 48 durability at a 16 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Wing Shield
item.description: A rare wing shield with independently rolled Battle Brothers-style modifiers. A reinforced wooden heater shield made from the finest materials and quite obviously crafted by a master shield maker.
item.role: +26 melee defense, +15 ranged defense; 32 durability at a 14 fatigue cost, with two permanent rolled bonuses.

item.name: Sipar Shield
item.description: A full metal round shield of southern design. Quite heavy, but also durable.
item.role: +18 melee defense, +18 ranged defense; 60 durability at a 18 fatigue cost.

item.name: Kraken Shield
item.description: This shield, carved out of a horn plate taken from a giant kraken, is stronger than any common shield. Adapted as equipment; source regeneration and magical effects are not simulated.
item.role: +24 melee defense, +24 ranged defense; 50 durability at a 15 fatigue cost.

item.name: Lindwurm Shield
item.description: This sturdy shield fashioned from the shimmering scales of a Lindwurm makes for protection nigh indestructible. Adapted as equipment; source regeneration and magical effects are not simulated.
item.role: +17 melee defense, +25 ranged defense; 64 durability at a 14 fatigue cost.

item.name: Living Tree Shield
item.description: This shield carved out of the remains of a living tree slowly regrows if it sustains any damage. At a glance, it almost looks as if its grotesque face is still moving. Adapted as equipment; source regeneration and magical effects are not simulated.
item.role: +20 melee defense, +17 ranged defense; 40 durability at a 12 fatigue cost.

item.name: Old Wooden Shield
item.description: An old round wooden shield.
item.role: +15 melee defense, +15 ranged defense; 16 durability at a 10 fatigue cost.

item.name: Decayed Heater Shield
item.description: A rotten triangular wooden shield covered with leather, canvas and moss.
item.role: +20 melee defense, +15 ranged defense; 24 durability at a 14 fatigue cost.

item.name: Worn Kite Shield
item.description: An elongated wooden shield that offers good protection also to the lower body. Somewhat bulky to handle in close combat engagements.
item.role: +15 melee defense, +20 ranged defense; 40 durability at a 16 fatigue cost.
